mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_HASH, USERNAME, CREATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, REVOKED FROM AUTH_SESSION WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTH_SESSION (TOKEN_HASH, USERNAME, CREATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, REVOKED) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{username}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revoked})
mapper.update: UPDATE AUTH_SESSION SET REVOKED=TRUE WHERE TOKEN_HASH=#{tokenHash}
UPDATE AUTH_SESSION SET REVOKED=TRUE WHERE USERNAME=#{username} AND REVOKED=FALSE
